authenticity_review: The image exhibits strong structural integrity for the objects present. All five umbrellas display correct geometry: domed canopies with visible rib lines radiating from central ferrules, straight black shafts terminating in J-hook handles, and plausible cast shadows on the cobblestone surface. The perceptual quality auditor noted only a slight 'darken' effect (severity 0.2) with no noise, compression artifacts, or blur. However, two minor generation artifacts are present: (1) the base of the second umbrella from the left shows slight melting/fusion into the cobblestone texture without a clean contact shadow boundary, and (2) subtle warping of the stone pattern immediately adjacent to umbrella handles suggests imperfect inpainting at object-ground interfaces. These are severity-1 texture anomalies that do not compromise overall authenticity but prevent a perfect score. The count error (5 vs 7) is an alignment issue, not an authenticity defect.
key_defects: Count mismatch: Image contains 5 umbrellas instead of the requested 7 (definitive failure, no partial credit warranted).
